tvShow.name: Flex X Cop
tvShow.overview: A chaebol cop joins forces with a gritty detective to take down criminals with a touch of wealth and a whole lot of wit.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Jin Isoo, the naïve heir of Hansu Group, gets into a fight with a stranger and Ganghyun arrests him.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: A model is found dead on a yacht. Isoo gets his first murder case and investigates with Ganghyun.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The team finds the key suspect in the model murder case. However, other suspects come to light.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: A famous painter has been murdered in an art gallery. Meanwhile, Yi Soo visits his childhood home.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Yi Soo captures the prime suspect in the painter's case, and he learns something unexpected.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The death of an elderly is all but simple. Kang Hyun works to prove it, and Yi Soo seeks other methods.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A bizarre body is found in an office. Isoo and Ganghyun start investigating the mysterious death.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: A man is caught at the suspect's house. Isoo investigates the link between the found item and death.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Isoo recovers memories with hypnosis and looks for Myeongchul. Meanwhile, an actress is found dead.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Isoo and Ganghyun discover the actress had a stalker and was harassed by him before her death.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: The sudden death of two people affiliated with Oryunhoe. Ganghyun tries to uncover the truth.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Isoo encounters Ganghyun at Oryunhoe, and they face a crisis of being exposed to the cult leader.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: An unknown body is found in Myeongchul's backyard amidst the election. Isoo investigates the case.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: The team arrests the suspect in the case. Meanwhile, Isoo discovers secrets within the household.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Shocked by unexpected news, Isoo is tormented. Meanwhile, Ganghyun investigates to help Isoo.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Truths start to unfold about his mother's death. Isoo is confronted with an unbearable reality.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Jin Yi-soo, a privileged heir, joins a police force specializing in robbery cases, leveraging his wealth and connections, but clashes with his no-nonsense partner, Detective Lee Kang-hyun.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: While filming a documentary, Isoo receives an anonymous threat: "Detective Jin. Let the game begin."

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After a string of attacks, Isoo flees to a safe house. The bomber's final message: "FINAL ROUND."

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Isoo and Hyera investigate a haunted house tip. They're attacked and wake up bound inside the house.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Five bodies are found in the abandoned house. Violent Crime Investigation Team 1 begins the hunt.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A concierge is found dead in a hotel room on White Day. Could this be a crime of passion?

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: While questioning the concierge's murder suspect, the hotel owner disappears. The team gives chase...

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A magician dies in a fire onstage. Isoo and Hyera are stunned to meet a man with his exact face.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The boss of the Hammurabi gang emerges as a new suspect. Isoo devises a plan to confront him.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Hyera tells Isoo she's hunting a serial killer. A arts student is found dead in a bizarre state.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: With the victim's three friends as suspects, Isoo works to decode the dying message.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Following a gruelling stint at the police academy, where his unruly nature frequently clashed with that of his hellish drill instructor, Isoo returns to work as a fully-fledged police officer, only to discover that his former instructor, Joo Hyera, is now the new leader of the violent crimes team. And as if that wasn't bad enough - the pair are now partners!

reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
I'm genuinely surprised by the low rating for Flexxcop. 

I can only surmise its  mediocre rating is from viewers who read the blurb about the series but never took the time, to watch it. Yes, on the surface it comes across as a romantic drama but its hardly that at all.

In fact, its predominantly a dark comedy, crime drama and quite a good one, at that. Crime tales are well told and the goofy antics of the entitled, rich, police officer, are actually pretty funny. Its almost got a Korean Magnum PI vibe (the original series not the crummy remake), if that makes sense.

Above average acting rounds out what is shaping up to be a really decent series.

In summary, far more a crime drama with a dash of dark humour, than a romantic comedy. Well worth a look.
